claim: A new expansion-robustness design on the sealed expansion panel meets LOIO >= 6/8 AND placebo PASS (funding-permutation null p95 < true C2-vs-B1 relative QLIKE reduction), which would upgrade the prior FRAGILE 19.04% PASS toward ROBUST. The prior sealed 19.04% PASS (LOIO 4/8, placebo null p95 21.10% >= true 19.04%) is FRAGILE and MUST NOT be re-scored as a PASS; this cell only tests whether a pre-registered, adequately-powered design changes that verdict.

why_this_is_new.ranking: Track A expansion robustness is the second-highest unfinished Track A item after the observed-liquidation confirmation. The prior cell was FRAGILE because the placebo null (21.10%) exceeded the true effect (19.04%).
why_this_is_new.design_change: This cell increases permutation resolution (2000 permutations) and uses a fixed-seed block bootstrap; it does NOT change the panel, splits, features, or the 2% materiality floor. If the true effect is genuinely below the placebo null, the verdict remains FRAGILE and that is the honest result.
why_this_is_new.no_relitigation: The sealed expansion panel and the prior FRAGILE verdict are not mutated. This cell writes a NEW verdict artifact.

verdict_rules.ROBUST: LOIO >=6/8 AND placebo PASS AND materiality AND CI excludes zero
verdict_rules.FRAGILE: primary passes but LOIO or placebo fails (matches prior verdict if unchanged)

constraints: No mutation of the sealed expansion panel or prior FRAGILE verdict.
No threshold shopping; do not lower the LOIO or materiality bars.
Do not re-score the prior FRAGILE PASS as a PASS.
